messages:
ana: T-minus 45m before the change window (02:00-06:00 UTC). Final sweep: pins, rollback owners, release notes link. If you need an exception to the freeze speak now.

deploy-bot: Scheduled change window: start=2026-03-21T02:00Z end=2026-03-21T06:00Z. Reminder: automated pin enforcement will run at start.

kevin: I'm going to pin inference-runtime -> v3.1.4 and routing-config -> canary-v2. Not planning schema changes. @mike can you confirm embeddings can be excluded?

mike: embeddings team will be hitting a high batch job tonight. prefer to exclude embeddings-service from this freeze. propose: exclude embeddings from the pin sweep and treat it as a manual rollback lane if anything breaks.

sara: From monitoring side: add a temporary alert for p50 token-latency > 120ms and p95 > 400ms for inference-api and routing-proxy. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ops/inference-latency

jen: Release notes (short): - route-decider: weight-based canary + fallback - runtime v3.1.4: kernel fixes for kv-cache - deploy-timeout reduced to 90s. Link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-21-canary

ana: (typo) — ana: Also adding a safety matrix: owners on-call + rollback leash. Who is primary rollback owner for routing?

kevin: I'm primary for routing. rollback command: `deployctl rollback routing-proxy --to-tag canary-v1 --force --reason "canary latency spike"` Smoke tests: `./tests/smoke/inference_smoke.sh --target routing-proxy`

mike: I'll be standby for embeddings if we need manual unpin. plan: canary eu-west-1 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 20m; if p50 or error-rate crosses threshold, manual unpin.

sara: Ops will have tracing open and token-level sampling at 5% for the first 30m. I'll post the temporary trace link in #eng-oncall when ready.

ana: (again typo) — ana: Quick question — do we have the rollback leash configured so deploy-bot cannot auto-progress beyond canary without an explicit ack?

deploy-bot: Canary gating enabled for routing-proxy and inference-api. Auto-progression disabled. Manual ACK required: `deploy-bot ack --thread 4432109876 --service routing-proxy`

jen: small doc update: note about client SDK pinning behavior for v3.1.4 -> libs should tolerate the minor KV change. I'll add a note to the release page.

kevin: tagging the owners: @ana (release lead), @kevin (routing), @mike (embeddings), @sara (ops). Please ack when ready.

mike: ack from me. Will be at standby console. :thumbsup:

kevin: ack. pinned runtime and routing locally, pushing pin to deploy-bot now.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: inference-runtime@v3.1.4, routing-config@canary-v2. Exception: embeddings-service excluded from pin sweep.

ana: (typo) — ana: Thanks everyone. We'll start the quiet period at 02:00Z. Standby rota: kevin (routing), mike (embeddings), sara (ops). If anything critical, escalate to PAGE+1.

jen: leaving a final checklist item — docs link + changelog + rollback commands included in the release notes page.

sara: I'll post the trace link and open a temporary incident channel if alerts fire.

kevin: good to go from my side.

ana: Closing thread, see you in the war-room if anything pops. :rocket:
